jobs.title: ICT System Administrator (UNIX/LINUX and Windows)
jobs.summary: ICT System Administrator (UNIX/Linux and Windows) at the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in IT and three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Information Technology/Computer Science (NQF Level 6). Minimum three 3 years relevant experience in IT, of which at least one (1) year should be in a Unix/Linux server environment. Job-Related Knowledge: Unix/ Linux and Windows Server administration and management. Active Directory and Group Policy. Exchange administration. Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration. Hyper-V virtualisation. Knowledge of hardware and software troubleshooting. Server monitoring and performance management. DHCP, DNS and TCP/IP. File and print. Job Related Skills: Experience on server operating systems, including installation, configuration and maintenance. Cloud services and hybrid infrastructure management. Automation and scripting. Good collaborative skills and ability to work well within a team. Attention to detail. Drive and critical thinking. Technical Competence. A Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Maintain Hardware and Software Infrastructure: Provisioning of Unix/ Linux and Windows server infrastructure and support. Unix/Linux and Windows Server Maintenance. Active Directory Administration. Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration. Troubleshooting and monitoring both Unix/Linux and Windows server environments. Ensure ICT governance and risk management. Research Future Trends and Technologies: Testing new Hardware and Software in the market. Research new trends in market and make recommendations. Zero Trust Security. AI and Predictive Analytics, Machine Learning, internet of things etc. Contribution in Projects: Rollout of special projects. Investigate and plan software and hardware projects.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email ICTSArecruit87@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Females and persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates, for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. jobs.title: Senior Agricultural Scientist (SENIOR Lecturer)
jobs.summary: Senior Agricultural Scientist (Senior Lecturer) position in Middelburg, Eastern Cape, overseeing academic curriculum development in animal science, requires a BSc in Agriculture and 3 years of higher education experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor of Science Degree (BSc) in Agriculture (Animal Science). Minimum of 3 years’ experience in the higher education environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge and understanding of all relevant legislation and regulations that govern the Public Service. Knowledge of Government policies and priorities in terms of Agriculture. Knowledge and understanding of the white paper on the transformation of the Public Service (Batho Pele). A strong knowledge of the subject area combined with a broad subject background enabling contributions to teaching programmes. Job related skills: Computer skills. Good knowledge of the subject field. Supervisory and management skills. Formal training and presentation skills/facilitation skills. Willingness to work extended hours. The ability to work proactively and under pressure. The ability to work efficiently and effectively at all times. A valid driver’s licence. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development and implementation of the academic curriculum for the subject field according to the relevant quality standards which would, inter alia, include the following: Determine the training needs of clients and industrial role players (Liaise with relevant agricultural role players). Identify gaps in the curriculum, review and develop appropriate interventions, e.g. course material / study guides. Compile a curriculum. Ensure alignment of course material with requirements set for academic institutions and practical requirements. Participate in peer reviewing of study material and presentations. Prepare syllabus guides, lesson plans and presentation of practical, theoretical and/or short courses in accordance with the set timetable. Ensure that assessment and moderation of assessments take place in accordance with the required standards (e.g. Higher Education Quality Committee standards). Develop and implement a capacity-building plan. Conduct classes which would, inter alia, include the following: Conduct classes which would, inter alia, include the following. Prepare practical and theoretical lecturing material and study aids. Present lectures and tutorials. Maintain discipline during classes. Compile question papers and memorandums for assessments. Grade answer sheets, papers and assignments. Statistical analysis of results. Invigilate during exams and tests as required. Support students through an advisory and consultative role. Moderation of exams as required. Present short courses / vocational training to Higher Education and Training (HET), Further Education and Training (FET) students and other stakeholders. Liaise with industry at various platforms on different aspects of vocational training. Prepare practical material and study aids. Present practical classes and assessment. Provide oversight, guidance, mentoring and assistance to students and other stakeholders in the planning (strategic, operational, fodder flow and financial) and management (day-to-day livestock operations, data collection and marketing) of production units (mini farms). Provide oversight to students / stakeholders in the collection, processing and interpretation of data of the production unit. Ensure the provision of sufficient quantity and quality of practical training material and equipment (fleeces, livestock, equipment, etc.). Oversee and conduct applied information research on production units: Do desktop research on subject matter. Identify relevant new information and technology for incorporation in course material. Present findings of research at relevant platforms. Provide verbal and written advice and assistance to farmers in subject field. Perform and oversee administrative and extracurricular functions which would, inter alia, entail the following: Give input towards policy. Involved with planning regarding academic, facilities, financial and other related issues. Compilation of timetables. Perform and oversee administration in terms of classes e.g. attendance registers, student records, exam results etc. Serve on various committees (e.g. subject academic committees etc.). Compile and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Human resource responsibility including: Supervise subordinates. Development of subordinates. Maintain discipline. Plan and prioritise work of subordinates. Performance management. Monitor expenditure and utilisation of assets. Comply with the Public Service prescripts.

jobs.summary: Human Resource Practitioner focusing on recruitment and selection for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma in HR Management and one year of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Must be in possession of grade 12 certificate and National Diploma in Human Resource Management (NQF 6). The candidate must have a minimum of 1 year experience in Recruitment and Selection Environment. Job Related Work Experience: Knowledge of recruitment and selection prescripts and legislation. Knowledge of human resource transformation, monitoring and evaluation. Knowledge of Public Service Act. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations. Knowledge of Employment Equity Act. Knowledge of Labour Relations Act. Knowledge of Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Job Related Skills: the applicant must have good communication (verbal and written). Good interpersonal relations. Ability to communicate well with people at different level. Planning and organising skills. Problem solving skills. Good telephone and email etiquette. Presentation and facilitation. Report writing. Record keeping. People management. Monitoring and evaluation. Negotiation and conflict resolution. Customer focus. Computer literacy. A Valid Driver’s License.
jobs.duties: Ensure the advertisement of vacant and funded posts. Ensure that duly completed and approved application to fill a Post Form is attached. Ensure that job description or job evaluation results are attached. Ensure that employment equity targets are attached. Draft advertisement in line with the approved job profile. Send draft advertisement to line manager for sign off before placement. Submit documents to advertising section for placement. Provide effective advisory service on recruitment and selection. Ensure adherence and compliance to R&S policy and prescripts. Administer the arrangement of shortlisting’s and interviews. Provide technical advisory services during shortlisting’s and interviews. Implement recommendations of the selection committee members. Draft appointment submission for approval. Conduct personnel suitability checks on recommended candidates. Issue appointment letters and regret letters. Provide assistance during recruitment and selection information sessions. Respond to all related enquiries. Meet with clients on daily operational issues. Write submissions and letters on matters related to recruitment and selection. Represent the unit at various transformation forums in the Department. Rendering secretariat services during shortlisting and interviews. Provide effective interpretation on legislations, policies and directives. Provide inputs on the amendment of policies and procedures. Draft written responses to line functionaries on functional areas to enhance correct implementation of recruitment and selection processes and practices. Follow up on vacancies with a view to reduce the vacancy rate and turnaround time to fill a post. Provide training on recruitment and selection policies and prescripts. Maintain and update database with statistics on the filling of posts. Maintain and provide statistical information on recruitment and selection. Update and maintain recruitment and selection vacancy databases. Control, maintain and monitor databases set up to monitor recruitment and selection activities.

jobs.summary: Senior Laboratory Assistant needed in Stellenbosch to perform routine sample analysis and quality control on agricultural, dairy and liquor products.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. A Minimum of 3 years relevant experience in Laboratory and Horticulture. Job Related Knowledge: Knowledge of the Public Service and Departmental prescripts /policies. Agricultural Product Standards Act 119 of 1990, Liquor Products Act 60 of 1989. Job Related Skills: Knowledge and application of the Laboratory quality systems. Knowledge of work-related policies and procedures. Laboratory techniques and safety. Problem solving techniques. Effective communication. Provisioning administrative system (chemicals, equipment etc). Data processing. Applicable relevant analytical techniques. Efficient managing of stores and ordering of miscellaneous stores. Use of relevant laboratory and office equipment. Manual dexterity. Communication capabilities. Insight capabilities in the application of quality assurance documentation. Accuracy, thoroughness and timeous Ness. Computer skills, application/usage of computer software. Alert and troubleshooting skills. Administrative and organisational skills Language capabilities with regard to the understanding of quality system documentation. Planning and organising abilities. Self developmentally inclined. Team building. Trainings skills/give guidance. Extended working hours. Handling of hazardous chemicals. Valid driver’s license and the ability to drive.
jobs.duties: Prepare samples and perform routine analysis for the determination of i.e. chemical resides / dairy / processed food/liquor products composition components (quality control) which would, inter alia, entail the following; Labelling of samples. Collecting/taking samples for preparation (i.e. fruit, vegetables, grain and or other agricultural products / processed foods bread, dried fruit, fruit juice, honey vinegar). Preparation of sample material by e.g. weighing, drying, cutting etc. Preparation of media (eliza kits). Preparation and staining of smears. Preparation of stains, buffers and reagents. Visual inspection and collection of infected material if applicable. Perform extractions and basic analyses of samples. Record analyses results. Storage of samples. Packing and/or transport samples. Assist in decontamination and disposal of used samples. Removal of waste. Perform basic maintenance on selected equipment and instrumentation. Report all faulty equipment and instrumentation. Perform verification and calibration on selected equipment and instrumentation. Maintain tidiness of laboratories, clean / sterilise glassware and equipment. Clean laboratory facilities. Clean glassware and laboratory equipment. Perform administrative and related functions which would inter alia, entail the following: Inventory control of equipment and consumable for equipment. Recordkeeping and updating of the identified register (i.e. Register book, sample referral, sample received, record of results, inventory of standards, reagents and chemicals, waste removal). Assist with invoicing of analyses. Comply with health and safety regulations.

jobs.centre: Department of Defence Headquarters Unit, Armscor Building, Erasmuskloof, Pretoria.
jobs.closing_date_text: 16 October 2026 at 16h00 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Administrative Secretary to the Deputy Chief of Staff SANDF at Defence Headquarters in Pretoria, requiring typing skills, MS Office proficiency and strong organisational abilities.
jobs.requirements: Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Typing skills. Language proficiency in English (written and verbal). Analytical and innovative thinking as well as problem-solving skills. Excellent Interpersonal Skills. Sound organisational skills. High level of reliability. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Good people skills. Ability to do analyse documents and situations. Excellent secretarial skills.
jobs.duties: Provide a Secretarial Support Service to Deputy Chief of Staff SANDF (DCOS). Receive telephone calls and refers the calls to the correct role. Record appointments and events in the dairy of the DCOS. Operate office equipment like fax and photocopying machine. Liaises with travelling agencies to make travelling arrangements for DCOS. Processes travel and subsistence claims for DCOS. Arrange meetings and events for DCOS. Book venues, invites role player, organise refreshments and set up schedules for meetings and events. jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Cabinet and Cluster Coordination in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma and five years' relevant experience including three at junior management level.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Public Administration/ Management, Development Studies or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Cluster Coordination, Intergovernmental Relations/Secretarial or relevant field of which three (3) years should be at entry /junior management level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Knowledge of government planning, monitoring and decision-making frameworks, Government policies and prescripts, Department procedures, programmes and priorities; environmental and development issues; work of Government planning and reporting mechanisms. Facilitate and coordinate planning, monitoring and reporting processes, including allocated SONA, MTDP and other government planning processes; Manage and maintain accurate Cabinet and Cluster documentation, submissions, decisions and correspondence, and ensure that documents are stored, circulated and archived in accordance with MISS requirements and departmental protocols.

jobs.summary: Control Environment Officer sought in Pretoria to administer environmental authorisations under NEMA, reviewing EIA reports and processing Section 24G and 30A applications.
jobs.requirements: A 4-year degree in Environmental Management/ Science or Natural Science or relevant equivalent qualification (NQF 8) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 6 years post qualification experience in the related field. Appropriate knowledge and experience in the application of National Environmental Management Act (Act 107 of 1998) (NEMA), as amended, NEMA Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2014 (GN No, R982 of 4 December 2014, as amended) and National Environmental Management Waste Act. Knowledge of EIA Regulations, the integrated environmental management and its application. Extensive knowledge of sustainable development ideals and objectives, and all associated integrated environmental management instruments and tools. Understanding of the policy and legislative framework governing environmental management in general and legislative process. Experience in the administration and review of EIA’s and the dynamics of EIA’s administration systems. Applicants must have the following skills: Advance computer skills, Project management skills, report writing skills and good communication skills (written or oral). Applicants must be able to work individually and, in a team, and must have the ability to work under pressure without supervision. Applicants must be willing to travel extensively and have a valid driver’s license.

Review and process a Section 24G and 30A applications in terms of NEMA and its Regulations, 2014 as amended. Establish and/or maintain relationships with key stakeholders on a monthly or bi-monthly or quarterly meetings or forums. Manage, respond and/ or delegate queries from stakeholders. Manage, guide and advise Control Environmental Officers and Case Officers. Coordinate and interact with stakeholders and provide guidance during planned and impromptu meetings as well as during site visits to clarify EIA related matters. Review and/ or provide technical input to Appeals Response Reports (ARRs). Support Regulatory Services with compliance monitoring and enforcement. Participate in the South African Wind Energy Association (SAWEA) and Strategic Infrastructure Projects (SIPs) meetings for EIA applications lodged with the Department. Respond to Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA) requests, Ministerial and Parliamentary queries.

jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 19 October 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Senior Legal Administration Officer needed to manage litigation matters, determine state liability, and provide legal support services.
jobs.requirements: LLB degree or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 8 years post qualification experience in the provision of legal services. Knowledge of Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, Environmental Law, PAJA, the rules of the various courts, including but not limited to the rules of the various High Courts and Magistrate’s Courts. Knowledge and experience in judicial review applications. Knowledge of environmental laws will be an added advantage. Skills: Sound Organising and Planning; computer literacy; creativity; basic project management; good communication; presentation and reporting; good analytical and research skills, good drafting skills, an ability to work in a team, a pro-active, problem-solving and positive attitude and an ability to adhere to deadlines are essential, leadership and facilitation. Strong diplomatic skills. The successful candidate should be able to work long hours and to travel to the various courts and do site inspections when required. A Valid Code B drivers’ license and willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Manage Litigation Matters. Determine liability on Losses and Damages to State Property. Provide high-quality litigation and related legal support services, including alternative dispute resolution assistance, which enables the Department of Environment, Forestry and Fisheries (Department) to protect and conserve the environment. Create an enabling environment for compliance with the prescripts of the Department. Assist the Department to improve co-operative and corporate governance, improved service delivery and promotion of empowerment. Provide litigation management services and general legal advice and ensure compliance by the Department with the legislative framework relating to its core business and adherence to the Rules of Court. Attend to matters related to the determination of liability of officials who have caused losses/damages to State property and/or vehicles, where officials or third parties are found liable for any obligations towards the Department. Manage and facilitate the recovery of such obligations with the assistance of the State Attorney. Assist the Department to ensure compliance with the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 (Act No.3 of 2000) (PAJA) for the Department. Periodically conduct training and information sharing sessions regarding litigation and losses and damages to State Property. Provide legal support and legal advice on the interpretation of environmental legislation and the Promotion of Access to Information Act or the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act in appeal related matters. Provide litigation support, including compilation of court records, and attend to consultations with legal counsel on appeal decisions taken on review. Draft ministerial submissions.

jobs.closing_date_text: 19 October 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pretoria to coordinate youth graduate and contractor development initiatives within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Training and Development, Developmental Studies or a relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Education, Training and Development (ETD) or a relevant field. Knowledge and understanding of Skills Development Act, National Youth Policy, National Development Plans, Employment Equity Environmental Legislation. Knowledge of Expanded Public Works Programmes (EPWP), Integrated sustainable rural development and urban renewal programmes. Have experience in financial, project / programme and personnel management. Knowledge and understanding of project planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and compliance. Must possess skills in leadership, coordination and project management, communication (written and verbal), listening, report writing and decision-making. Ability to develop and apply policies, establish and maintain interpersonal relationships, work independently and as part of a team. Manage and resolve conflict. An applicant must further possess personal attributes such as being innovative and proactive, demonstrating initiative, being responsible and loyal, having ability to work under extreme pressure, ability to work long hours when required, and ability to gather, analyse and interpret information and reports.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the planning and implementation of youth graduate and contractor development initiatives. Support the development of emerging enterprises through skills and business enhancement initiatives for sustainability. Initiate and support the development and implementation of the procurement plan for youth graduate and contractor development initiatives. Coordinate project compliance with EPWP prescripts. Verify monthly progress reports and supporting evidence. Evaluate invoices for payment purposes. Maintain project records and manage the reporting of youth graduate and contractor development projects. Facilitate the development and review of youth and contractor development strategy, implementation plans and reporting tools Provide support on youth career pathing initiatives by conducting career guidance workshops and training for youth graduates’ programmes. Participate in internal and external youth forums. Facilitate the establishment and management of partnerships with external stakeholders, including NYDA, Municipalities, Public Entities, SETAs, QTCO and other relevant government departments. Draft Memoranda of Understanding MoUs and Memoranda of Agreements (MoAs) and lead the vetting process. Manage partnership agreements and ensure projects alignment with National Development Goals.

jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Programme Monitoring and Evaluation at Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.

Knowledge and Understanding of Monitoring and Evaluation, government legislation and prescripts, Project Management, Administrative procedures, Financial Management, Accounting & Business practices, Strategic planning and budgeting. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop, interpret and apply policies, strategies and legislation, HR management practices, legal issues, negotiations and dealing with conflict. Assist in career planning and effective deployment of personnel. Supply Chain Management policies and procedures. Extensive experience in Expanded Public Works Programme. Computer software packages and efficient use of associated hardware. such as MS Access, Excel, STATA and ATLAS TI such as MS Access, Excel, STATA and ATLAS TI Perform in-house training for subordinates Ability to work long hours voluntarily, Ability to gather and analyse information, Ability to develop and apply policies, Ability to work individually and in team, Ability to work under extreme pressure, Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict Skills. Character beyond approach. willingness to travel long distances for an extended period(s). A valid driver’s license will be an added advantage.

Contribute to the process of identifying focus areas for monitoring and evaluation Conduct desktop analysis of all active projects, Capture data from the fieldwork, analyse and develop reports with recommendations. Communicate findings of the programme monitoring and evaluation reports to the relevant stakeholders. Contribute to the development and implementation of a coordinated M&E system for the EP, Contribute in the process of developing and review of M&E Framework and M&E plans Monitor adherence to the provisions of the M&E Framework. Contribute to the dissemination of the Framework and the M&E plans to the stakeholders. Develop action plans for implementation of recommendations from the programme monitoring and evaluation reports. Follow up on the Implementation of the recommendations from programme monitoring and evaluation reports, Coordinate and monitor the implementation of recommendations from the programme monitoring and evaluation reports. Develop progress reports on implementation of recommendations from the programme performance monitoring and evaluation reports, Facilitation of external evaluation studies: Facilitate confirmation of the area for evaluation, facilitate appointment of External Evaluators: Confirm the evaluation scope and determine methodology to be employed, Coordinate the data collection process and make inputs to the evaluation report, Facilitate the communication of findings and approval of the evaluation reports. Contribute to the Development of the monitoring and evaluation newsletters: Source information mainly from the finalised and approved Programme Monitoring and Evaluation reports Prepare articles for the newsletter. Contribute to the process of finalising the newsletters, circulation/ publication to the stakeholders within the branch.

jobs.title: Regional Coordinator
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus 37 % in lieu of benefits
jobs.closing_date_text: 19 October 2026, 16:00. No late applications will be accepted
jobs.summary: Regional Coordinator in Pretoria overseeing waste tyre collection and transportation services, requiring a National Diploma and two years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF 6) or higher in Transport Management/ Logistics, Environmental Management / Environmental Sciences or relevant equivalent qualification recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in Environmental Management or relevant field. Knowledge and Understanding of Project management, General Administration, Financial Administration, Departmental procedures and prescript/policies. Knowledge of environmental management. Knowledge and exposure in depot operations. Ability to develop, interpret and apply policies, strategies and legislation. Knowledge and exposure in depot operations. Knowledge of waste management processes and procedures. Knowledge in logistics. Sound organising and planning skills. Good communications skills. Coordination skills. Computer literacy. Report Writing skills. Ability to work under pressure. Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work long hours voluntary. Ability to work independently. Responsible and loyal. Honest and reliable. A valid driver’s licence will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Ensure the improvement of Waste Tyre collection and transportation services; Compile monitoring report on the collection service. Monitor the allocated collection points on a quarterly basis. Update the collection schedule. Keep files and records of all Monitored participants. Receive and attend to queries and complaints. Ensure compliance to relevant legislation by participants. Conduct sites visits at collection points, depots and processors. Undertake compliance promotions to legislation. Compile compliance report. Make follow up of the recommendations and comments made. Ensure the verification of the signed Service Level Agreements (SLA). Consolidate report from depot operators monthly. Plan and arrange compliance session with the transporters. Facilitate payments of transporters and depot operators. Verify and capture collection notes and monthly reports from all allocated transporters and depot operators on a weekly and monthly basis respectively. Receive invoices with their respective supporting documents. Verify and submit the allocated invoice spreadsheets together with invoices. Load invoices, collection notes and monthly reports on Electronic Document Management System (EDMS). Keep files and recoils of all the invoices verified. Contribute toward increasing the processing of collected waste tyres. Receive secondary industry applications from the applicants. Verify and process the secondary industry applications received within two weeks after receipt of the full applications. Conduct a pre- approval inspection. Compile an inspection report within two days after site assessments. Provide feedback to the applicant on the status of the applications. Keep database records and processed applications received. Receive secondary industry monthly processing tonnages reports Load the monthly tonnages reports on EDMS. Keep files and records of the reports received. Provide feedback to the Managers. Keep files and records of the verification reports.

A minimum of two years (2) relevant experience in Supply Chain Management or relevant field. Knowledge of Supply Chain Management processes. Knowledge of the Logistical Management System (LOGIS). Knowledge of relevant legislative framework Public Finance Act (PFMA), National Treasury Regulations, PPPFA, Public Service Policies, Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations. Ensure that the asset register is updated (RR032 asset report) in every location. Manage the asset disposal process. Ensure that assets are disposed according to the correct disposal procedures. Manage the verification process for assets to be disposed. Manage the asset lifecycle. Stakeholder liaison. Attend to queries regarding asset management. Facilitate and coordinate the reporting of losses and damages of assets. Supervision of asset unit.

jobs.summary: Dock Master position at Kalk Bay Fishing Harbour managing vessel slipping operations, requiring Grade 12 or trade test with three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate (NQF 4) /or Appropriate Trade Test Certificate. Must have a minimum of three (3) years’ experience as a Docker or relevant. Knowledge of dry docking. Knowledge and understanding of the Marine Living Resources Act, 1998 (Act No. 18 of 1998) and the regulations promulgated thereunder. Basic understanding of the Occupational Health and Safety Act,1993. Skills in general administration, maintenance and equipment and basic finance principles. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Initiate and plan the slipping of vessels. Analyse the vessel docking plan to assess material and capacity to be used. Assign team to build bilge blocks and the wedges for the main slip. Ensure safety at the slipway in the water and on land. Communicate with divers and dockers in dinghy in the water that the vessel is enroute. Apply safety adjustments measures whilst pulling out of the water and secure cradle and vessel on land. Ensure continuous alignment and adjustment of bilge blocks while cradle is in motion. Side slipping of vessels. Pulling vessel/cradle to side slip utilizing high tension steel cables. Off-load side slip equipment for safe storage.

jobs.title: Director: Municipal Desk
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (all – inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Director role at GTAC in Pretoria leading municipal public-private partnership projects, requiring a relevant bachelor's degree and expertise in public finance management.
jobs.requirements: A relevant bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) as recognised by SAQA in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Law, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, is required. A postgraduate qualification (NQF Level 8) in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or Law will be considered an added advantage. Specialised expertise in public finance management and/or public-private partnership (PPP) structuring will be highly advantageous. Minimum of five (5) years' relevant experience in project finance, project management, regulatory compliance management, and/or public-private partnership (PPP) structuring. 5 years' experience at a middle or senior management level. Experience within the public sector will be regarded as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: To enable the establishment and management of PPP projects that achieve the requirements of substantial risk transfer, value for money and affordability for local government infrastructure build and service delivery programmes. PPP Policy and Regulatory Framework: Provide inputs to the development, annual reviews and ongoing formulation of the NT PPP policy, regulations and practice notes, NT PPP Manual, NT Standardised PPP Provisions and related PPP Guidelines. Provide inputs to the development, implementation and updating of standardised Sectoral PPP Toolkits for the establishment of PPP systems, standards and contracting terms. Provide inputs into the design, development, implementation and maintenance of tools, methodologies and guidelines to enable the appraisal of PPP feasibility studies, structuring of procurement transactions, and management of PPP projects. Track / research / investigate and report/advise/make recommendations on latest trends and best practices in the PPP management, stakeholder views and experience in PPP implementation, lessons learnt through PPP projects, PPP market shortcomings, fiscal implications and policy gaps in the government development agenda for public infrastructure and improvements to the PPP value proposition. TAS&PPP Marketing and Communications and PPP Advocacy: Provide inputs into and support the design, development and implementation of marketing strategies and targeted initiatives designed to broaden the PPP market and increase PPP competitiveness and share of total infrastructure spend including, inter alia, public events, awareness and promotional campaigns, targeted engagements, and liaison with national and international media. Establish and maintain working relationships and ongoing engagements and liaison with NT PPP policy, regulatory and audit stakeholders, local government PPP procuring institutions stakeholders and private sector stakeholders. Provide information and assistance to investors, bidders and financiers about PPP programmes and upcoming opportunities. Assist with and ensure the resolution and reporting of stakeholder queries for assimilation into PPP training manuals and communications materials. PPP Projects Inception Advice and Support: Manage the provision of advice to local government institutions on initiating potential PPP projects in compliance with Treasury Regulation 16 including conducting initial needs analyses, registering PPPs with relevant treasury, appointing project officers, delegations and responsibilities, assessing projects budgets and considering PDF funding and setting up projects teams. Manage discussions on proposed PPPs with the Accounting Officer / Authority and confirm/obtain agreement on the project needs analysis and delivery options, budget availability, project consultants (if any), PDF funding application (if any), internal project management capacity, political and management support for the project, appointed project officer, multiple project bundling (if any), and project timeframe. Manage the processing of written requests from the Accounting Officer / Authority to register PPP projects including the assignment of a project number and the PPP Unit project advisor, entering the project on the PPP projects database and confirming, in writing to the Accounting Officer / Authority, the project registration and details, and the request for the appointment of a Transaction Advisor. Manage the provision of technical support to the PPP project officer on setting up the project office including assisting and/or organising technical assistance with calculating project management and administration, and Transaction Advisor costs, identifying budget availability and building into next budget cycle, assessing PDF funding needs, if any, establishing a project secretariat and project team , drafting the terms of reference for the Transaction Advisor and procuring and/or seconding project expertise as required. Manage the provision of technical support on PDF applications including assisting with PDF applications preparation, providing recommendations on the application, informing the accounting officer/authority of the PDF's decision, assisting with funding agreements preparation and signing, and ensuring that conditions are met and the PDF Unit takes over funding the Transaction Advisor. Manage the provision of technical support and advice on the procurement of the PPP Transaction Advisor including the establishment of the bid evaluation panel and bid secretariat, defining of the Transaction Advisor terms of reference, setting out of the appointment, reporting and decision-making arrangements for the Transaction Advisor, preparation of the bid package, publishing of the advertisement, briefing of bidders, and responding to queries, evaluation of bids and interviewing, selection and contracting of the Transaction Advisor. PPP Feasibility Studies Appraisal and Advice: Manage the provision of technical advice and support on the preparation of PPP project feasibility studies including the needs analysis, solution options analysis, project due diligence, value assessment, economic valuation, and procurement plan. Manage the appraisal of PPP project feasibility studies / revised feasibility studies and the provision of recommendations and motivation thereto for Treasury Approval I or decline including appraising/organising the appraisal of the projects’ merits, alignment with government priorities and demand, affordability, value-for-money and appropriate risk allocation, cost- effectiveness and likelihood of implementation. PPP Procurement Support and Advice: Facilitate the provision of advice and technical assistance on preparing affordable and cost-effective PPP projects including the design of procurement transaction frameworks and processes including optimum financial structure for the project, sources of debt and likely financing terms, and financing implications of project contracts, preparation of financial memoranda on the project for presentation and identification and mobilisation of development finance institutions (national and international) and/or commercial banks as necessary. Manage the provision of technical support and advice on the PPP procurement process and Treasury approvals IIA and IIB including the: preparation of Requests for Qualification (RFQ), obtaining TR IIA, advertising and distribution of the RFQ, evaluation of responses, and communication with bidders, preparation of Requests for Proposal (RFP), obtaining TR IIA, advertising and distribution of the RFP, evaluation of bids, and choosing of the preferred bidder / entering, where required, the best and final offer (BAFO) process, preparation of the Value-for-Money Report and Negotiation plan and obtaining TR IIB. Manage the provision of technical support and advice on the negotiations and preparation of the draft PPP agreement and ancillary agreements (service level agreements, funding agreements and payment mechanism) and the PPP agreement management plan. Manage the assessment and compilation of draft PPP agreements and preparation and submission of the TA:III Report for Treasury approval including ensuring that: the PPP agreement meets the requirements of affordability, value for money and substantial technical, operational and financial risk transfer as approved , the management plan explains the capacity of the institution and proposed mechanisms and procedures to implement, manage, enforce, monitor and report on the PPP, the due diligence, including the legal due diligence, has been completed in respect of the accounting officer's or accounting authority / proposed private party competence and capacity to enter into the PPP agreement, recommendations and motivations thereto are made for Treasury approval / decline. PPP Projects Monitoring and Evaluation, Reviewing and Auditing and Closure and Reporting: Manage the development and implementation of corrective measures for projects that stray from the agreement management plan and punitive measures in instances of persistent non-performance. Provide inputs into PPP project efficiencies and effectiveness reviews and make and facilitate the implementation of recommendations, if any, for improvements regarding PPP transactions and arrangements, PPP financial models and plans and PPP project agreements and contracts management. Assist with and support the auditing of PPP projects and ensure the implementation of findings and/or resolution of adverse outcomes. Manage the provision of inputs on project findings and learnings reports and collate and submit for publishing and communication. Manage the provision of inputs on case studies and impact assessments on closed PPP projects. Manage the post-closure of PPP project contracts M&E including the provision of contract management assistance to procuring authority. PPP Capacity Development and Knowledge Management: Provide inputs on the design and development of training programmes and materials to build capacity to within all three spheres of government on the NT PPP Manual, Standardised PPP Provisions, Sectoral PPP Toolkits, PPP guidelines specifically the Municipal Service Delivery and PPP Guideline, and TAS&PPP tools and methodologies. Support the scheduling and implementation of PPP capacity development programmes including the Municipal training programme for local government officials and the private sector. Monitor and mentor Transaction Advisor interns in order to develop affordable, cost- effective PPPs. Build and participate in network groups for reference and benchmarking, and knowledge exchange and sharing, and attend Treasury workshops to ensure that all legislative and regulatory frameworks are updated. Provide inputs to the PPP quarterly report including the writing of articles. Disseminate and share PPP case studies and learnings and PPP quarterly reports with relevant stakeholders. TAS&PPP Strategy, Budget and Governance: Provide inputs to the TAS&PPP APP and manage the development, implementation, monitoring and reporting on the unit annual workplan and performance indicators. Provide inputs to the TAS&PPP budget preparation, expenditure, compliance and performance monitoring, record keeping and reporting. Contribute to and assist with the establishment and maintenance of the TAS&PPP management framework and internal controls including policies and procedures, business processes, guidelines and templates, and systems and databases. Support and enable TAS&PPP audits, including the preparation and availability of documentation and information, and the implementation of corrective measures regarding audit findings. TAS&PPP Staff and Resources Performance Management: Assist with and contribute to staff capacity and productivity management including the establishment of posts, recruitment of staff, delegation of work, and resolution of issues. Assist with and contribute to own and staff performance management and development including work plans and indicators development, performance reviewing and skills plans implementation. Monitor and ensure compliance with the TAS&PPP electronic and paper document management system and filing and archiving plan. TAS&PPP Information Management and Reporting: Prepare and supply information and documents for compliance checking and auditing purposes. Prepare and supply monthly status reports, quarterly progress reports and annual overview reports. Prepare and supply information for inclusion in the GTAC annual report, GBS, BCS and other donor funding reports, and other strategic documents.

jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and Four-year B or BSc Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualifications as recognised by South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5 (2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level in a Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post- registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job- related knowledge: Budget systems. Computer accounting software. Knowledge of Financial Accounting Systems. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Cadastral Survey knowledge. Technical System Knowledge. Cadastral Spatial Information Knowledge. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance management and Monitoring. Public Finance Management. Government systems and structure. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Job-related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business and Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage the approval of diagrams, general plans and sectional title plans that comply with legislation and prove tenure security and sustainable rural and urban development. Examine for approval all cadastral documents (diagrams and general plans). Examine for approval all cadastral documents (sectional plans) prepared in accordance with the Sectional Titles Act and all applicable statutory consents. Examine for approval all cadastral documents prepared in accordance with the Mining Titles Registration Act or any other law requiring the approval of the Surveyor-General. Archive, preserve and maintain the currency of all records pertaining to approved land parcels and land rights created in terms of the Land Survey Act and Sectional Titles Act and Regulations. Ensure that all approved cadastral documents are registered and housed within a secure documents vault. Ensure an electronic repository of scanned images to facilitate information provisioning. Update, endorse, re- scan and re-archive the hard copy (original approved) documents because of any lawful approval, withdrawal, cancellation or change to cadastral information. Accept and file survey records associated with cadastral surveys. Maintain correspondence files relating to cadastral surveys for research purposes. Ensure the compilation of a complete, accurate, current and correct cadastral spatial information dataset. Update the cadastral geo-spatial database through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Ensure that management information systems are created to provide timely and accurate management information constantly. jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Land Reform Specialist at Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a LLB or Bachelor of Commerce in Law. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in the relevant filed. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of contract management. Knowledge of public service management framework. Knowledge of policy development. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Facilitation and presentation. Financial management. Team management. Conflict management. Problem solving. People management. Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
jobs.duties: Conduct quality assurance of submissions for legal compliance. Review and assess submissions enroute to National Land Acquisition and Allocation Control Committee (NLAACC) and joint venture agreements, for legal and policy compliance. Conduct verification that supporting documentation is complete and legally sufficient. Verify alignment of agreements with applicable legislation, departmental policies, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Identify legal, financial, governance, and operational risks contained in agreements and recommend corrective actions. Prepare quality assurance reports with recommendations to correct deficiencies or achieve compliance for management approval. Monitor implementation of quality assurance recommendations. Provide technical advice on compliance and contract management matters. Manage, analyse, investigate, and report on enquiries relating to complaints. Receive, register, and acknowledge complaints and enquiries relating to Strategic Institutional Partnerships and land reform projects. Conduct preliminary assessments and determine the nature and severity of complaints. Gather and analyse relevant information, reports, agreements, and supporting documentation to identify root causes of disputes, complaints, and implementation challenges. Conduct investigations through stakeholder consultations, interviews, and site visits where necessary. Determining the legal, regulatory, and policy framework applicable to each matter. Draft investigation reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations. Maintain accurate reports of complaints and case outcomes. Provide advisory support to provinces regarding complaint management processes. Manage informal dispute resolution processes. Receive and assess disputes. Facilitate engagement sessions between beneficiaries, strategic partners, communities, landowners, and government stakeholders. Identify and analyse causes of conflicts arising from partnership agreements and project implementation. Mediate and negotiate amicable resolutions to disputes before escalation to formal legal processes. Develop dispute resolution strategies and action plans. Ensure all parties are informed of their rights, roles, and obligations. Draft settlement agreements and record outcomes of mediation processes. Monitor compliance with agreed resolutions and remedial actions. Escalate unresolved matters through appropriate governance and legal channels. Prepare and maintain records and reports on disputes managed and resolved. Promote stakeholder relations and collaborative problem-solving approaches. Development of policy and operational documents. Research and analyse policy gaps, implementation challenges, and emerging trends affecting Strategic Institutional Partnerships. Draft, review, and update policies, frameworks, guidelines, SOPs, terms of reference, templates, and operational manuals. Conduct benchmarking exercises against best practices and legislative requirements. Facilitate stakeholder consultations during policy development processes. Incorporate legal, governance, financial, and operational considerations into policy documents. Prepare policy submissions, concept documents, discussion papers, and implementation plans. Develop monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for policy implementation. Coordinate policy approval processes and stakeholder engagements. Review existing policies and recommend amendments where necessary. Provide technical support and guidance on policy interpretation and implementation. Training and capacitating provinces through workshops. Identify training and capacity-building needs within provincial and district offices. Develop training materials, presentations, manuals, toolkits, and guidelines. Facilitate workshops on land acquisition SOP, land allocation SOP, policy implementation and joint venture agreements. Conduct awareness sessions on legislative and policy developments. Provide technical support and mentoring to provincial officials. Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions. Prepare workshop reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. Coordinate stakeholder participation and logistics for workshops. Build institutional capacity through knowledge sharing and best practice dissemination. Prepare and maintain reports on the outcomes.

jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Principal Cadastral Officer (2 posts) at Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in a geomatics or cadastral survey environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alphanumeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of for proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancellation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principles and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. jobs.title: Principal Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral survey data for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in East London, requiring a Geomatics certificate and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in a geomatics or cadastral survey environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of for proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principles and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amended, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.

jobs.summary: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner: Logistics and Asset at Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.

Minimum of 2 years working experience in Supply Chain Management environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Departmental SCM and Asset management procurement policy. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Interpersonal skill. Communication (verbal and written) skills. Willingness to travel. Team work. Work under pressure and meet deadlines. Use a computer for prolonged periods.
jobs.duties: Generate purchase order. Capture and approve purchase order on Accpac system. Retrieve and verify outstanding purchase order report. Confirm goods and services rendered. Receipt and approval of purchase order for goods and services rendered. Track document number and print RCP. Submitted documents to Credits. Create goods received / receiving slips. Verify receipt of goods and services. Certify invoice for payment as per delegation of authority. Approval of RCP on the system. Coordinate travel arrangements. Receive travel forms and check completeness and compliance of the travel documents. Send document to travel agency to request a quotation. Capture travel request on workflow. Receive, verify compliance of travel bookings before PO is generated on the system. Approve PO on the system. Conducting asset verification, stock count and disposal. Receive, verify and check the availability of stock. Issue stock, update bin cards and system accordingly. Sign invoices and delivery notes upon delivery of stock. Update asset verification finding in the asset register. Check if asset verification findings are signed off and filed. Identify redundant, obsolete and unserviceable for disposal. Draft disposal memorandum. Impaired and disposal assets are updated in the asset register. Monitor all transfer assets within the deeds offices and other beneficiaries. Reconcile the asset register against general ledger. Record all assets of the department in the asset register. Update and monitor the utilisation of the assets by the relevant fields. Check that asset management systems are operating. Assist with compilation of comprehensive asset management plan. Check asset clearing account. Monitor all asset related accounts on Accpac system. Provide information and supporting documents on asset transactions to be journalized. Identify assets which must be reassessed.

jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least eight (8) years post qualification legal experience. Five (5) years’ experience in legal practice will be an added advantage. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good management skills. Proficiency in prosecution/litigation, competency in guiding investigations and giving instructions in reasonably complex or more difficult common law and statutory offences. Able to draft charge sheets and complex court documents. Ability to act independently without constant supervision. Must have good administrative skills. Prosecutorial/litigation experience in both District and Regional Courts. Required skills include general and strategic management, stakeholder engagement, people management and empowerment, communication, customer focus and responsiveness, problem-solving, decision-making, project management, administration, report writing, service delivery innovation, negotiation, policy analysis and development, research, presentation and facilitation. The applicant must be willing to travel within the DPP division and must possess a valid driver’s licence. The role also requires specifically the ability to manage, guide and train prosecutors; prosecute, guide investigations and issue instructions in reasonably complex or more difficult common law and statutory offences; draft charge sheets and complex court documents; and work independently without constant supervision. General computer literacy and knowledge of programs in Microsoft Office.
jobs.duties: Tutor aspirant prosecutors in an outcomes-based learning programme by guiding practical, theoretical and interactive learning activities. Assess learner competence, conduct and record assessment tasks, monitor progress and provide constructive feedback to learners and programme coordinators. Promote effective study skills, time management, independent learning and confidence in the subject matter. Maintain accurate attendance, progress and session records. Create an inclusive, respectful and safe learning environment that accommodates different learning styles and abilities. Liaise with relevant staff and stakeholders on learner progress, challenges and support needs. Perform related administrative duties and comply with applicable institutional policies, codes of conduct and safeguarding requirements. In addition, manage, supervise, train and mentor prosecutors; study case dockets and determine whether to institute and conduct criminal proceedings, maintenance matters and inquests of a general or more advanced nature in the Lower Courts; prepare matters for court by guiding investigations, consulting witnesses and obtaining additional evidence; draft charge sheets and other court documents; present and assist prosecutors in presenting the State’s case, leading witnesses, conducting cross-examination and addressing the court on conviction, sentence and related matters; and conduct prosecutions on behalf of the State. Perform all incidental and related duties in accordance with applicable legislation, the Code of Conduct, Ethics, the Prosecution Policy and NPA Policy Directives. Prioritise high-impact corruption and other matters; prepare opinions and heads of argument and argue matters in the appropriate court where a right of appearance exists. Conduct performance assessments and assist the Chief Prosecutor with staff assessments. Account to the Chief Prosecutor and the Director of Public Prosecutions as Head of Office. Manage, control and attend to the administration of the Lower Courts and any specific tasks assigned by the supervisor. Advise and assist the relevant Chief Public Prosecutor and/or DPP in identifying training needs, developing strategies to improve NPS performance and coordinating or presenting training interventions. Apply and promote Batho Pele Principles, the Service Charter and NPA processes. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in collaboration with stakeholders in the criminal justice system. Ensure victim-centred services.

jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: Judge’s Secretaries (12 posts) at Office of the Chief Justice in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Bachelor of Laws or relevant equivalent qualification at NQF level 8 with 480 credits as recognised by SAQA. Legal experience is required. Candidate to pass a typing test. A valid driver’s licence will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge on the Constitution of South, relevant legislatives, regulations, case lines, court online, secretariat prescripts, responsibilities, systems and procedures, Electronic Information Resources, online retrieval and Batho Pele principles. Skilled in communication, planning and organising, interpersonal, customer service, typing including Dictaphone typing, time management, Microsoft Office Programs, research capabilities, problem solving, judgment and decision making. Along with the following attributes: Assertive, meticulous, ability to work under pressure, time-bound, flexible, creativity, analytically, professionalism and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Diarise the appointments and meetings of the Judge, type and file the judgments, ensure the Judgments that are handed down (delivered), signed draft orders granted in court or virtually are sent to the Typist for scanning, upload unto Case-lines/Court-Online and the Library. Ensure that all visitors are received, screened and their queries are attended to, record all incoming and outgoing documents, order and collect stationery for the Judge, collect the files before the commencement of a Criminal matter from the Registrar’s office at the Criminal section, keep update the register of reviews and sign on receipt to return the reviews to the Clerk, ensure that the register/template of the reserved judgement is updated and notify the Statistics Officer and the office of the Judge President when judgment has been handed down, ensure that the transcribed judgements from transcribers reach the Judges for approval and signature, prepare court rolls for Opposed Motion and Urgent Court and distribute to stakeholders, ensure that the Heads of Argument from various stakeholders are available to the Judge as per the filing that was done, administer the correct Oath ID or declaration in court, when required, ensure that the bench book of the Judge is prepared and files are taken by Ushers to court before the commencement of the proceedings, ensure that all stakeholders involved are present in court before commencement of proceedings, ensure that all cases are called on record as per the court roll by means of calling the case number and the parties’ names, before a Judge can allow parties to start with their matters, ensure that in the Criminal Court exhibits are handled, controlled and noted professionally, ensure that all the travel, accommodation arrangements are in order and attend to sign the documents for approval, ensure that the Judge’s logbook is submitted on or before the 5th of every month to the Transport Officer, ensure that the car is booked for either maintenance and service, receive the pre-authorisation for the Judge’s vehicle, remind Judge of the invoices so that the submission of the S&T claims can be processed, ensure the submissions of Cell phone and 3G 68 data claims for process purposes and ensure that all updates on the loose leafs in the Judges library are attended to.

Compulsory registration as a professional Engineer (ECSA). Valid driver’s license. Knowledge of programme and project management, engineering, legal and operational compliance. Engineering operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting, engineering and professional judgment Strategic capability and leadership. Maintain engineering operational effectiveness. Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Provide Good Governance.
